name: Venom
summary: In Venom, you play as Rikka, a warrior and close friend of the ruler Arrel. After centuries of peace, the evil Traklan returns from his underground prison to once again threaten the land of Armosin. The journey begins outside the inn "Dancing Drayman," where Rikka plans to meet Arrel and Beris. From there, you explore the world with your companions, solve challenges, and confront the rising evil. The game is controlled via joystick or keyboard, using a command menu to perform actions such as moving, examining, or giving items.
